title: Performance.Ended
description: The payload of a performance's end (topic troupe.core.runs.performance:Performance.Ended): nothing more will happen in it. Recorded in the same batch as the event that settled it: its run's end, troupe's acceptance at the gate, or a person's answer. At most one. Absent: the performance's work waits at a gate, or its perform stopped without an end.

lineage.description: Where the event came from. It names this performance.

outcome.description: How it ended: completed when every step ran and its work was kept or there was none, failed when a step didn't succeed or its changes couldn't be captured, rejected when its work was rejected at a gate, cancelled when a step was cancelled.
